articles.title: Resetting a password
facts: A password-reset link expires after 30 minutes.

articles.title: Plans and workspace limits
facts: Starter supports 3 active boards; Team supports 25; Business is unlimited.

articles.title: Canceling a subscription
facts: Cancellation stops the next renewal and does not itself issue a refund.

articles.title: Board exports
facts: CSV export is available on Team and Business from Board menu > Export.

articles.title: Inviting guests
facts: Guests can access only boards to which they are explicitly invited.

articles.title: Mobile offline mode
facts: Offline editing is not supported; cached boards are read-only.

articles.title: Notification settings
facts: Email digests can be changed under Profile > Notifications.

articles.title: Supported browsers
facts: PilotDesk supports the latest two stable versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari.

articles.title: Feature requests
facts: Support may log a request but must not promise dates or roadmap commitment.

articles.title: Workspace deletion
facts: Deletion requests require specialist identity verification and must be escalated.

articles.title: Status page guidance
facts: Do not declare an outage unless the incident flag in the ticket context is active.

articles.title: Reporting a product bug
facts: Capture reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, OS, browser, and app version; do not request details already present.
